svg.title: Anterior chest and shoulder muscles
svg.desc: Anterior view. Patient right (viewer left): superficial pectoralis major, deltoid, serratus anterior, biceps, rectus abdominis and external oblique. Patient left (viewer right): pectoralis major and deltoid removed to expose pectoralis minor and the intercostal muscles between the ribs.
